BRIDE never cuts out: drains, then lifts (opacity changes smoothly, max step per frame)

(()=>{const ctx=window.__ctx;const br=ctx.rigs.find(r=>r.name==='bride');let prev=1,maxStep=0,last=0;for(let f=0;f<450;f++){window.renderAt(f/30);const o=+br.p.opacity;maxStep=Math.max(maxStep,Math.abs(o-prev));prev=o;if(o>0.001)last=f;}return{ok:maxStep<0.1,msg:'largest frame-to-frame opacity step '+maxStep.toFixed(3)+', last visible frame f'+last}})()

(()=>{const B=window.__bulbs[0];window.renderAt(0);let prev=[...B.level],bad=[];for(let f=0;f<450;f++){window.renderAt(f/30);B.level.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v>prev[i]+1e-6)bad.push('f'+f+' bulb'+(i+1));});prev=[...B.level];}window.renderAt(14.9);return{ok:bad.length===0,msg:bad.length?bad.join(','):'levels never rise; at f449 levels '+JSON.stringify(B.level.map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)))}})()
CTA1 pill word contrast (WHITE on PINK)

(()=>{const L=c=>{c/=255;return c<=0.03928?c/12.92:Math.pow((c+0.055)/1.055,2.4)};const lum=(r,g,b)=>0.2126*L(r)+0.7152*L(g)+0.0722*L(b);const cr=(1.05)/(lum(255,79,140)+0.05);return{ok:cr>=4.5,msg:cr.toFixed(2)+':1 — the brand pill colour cannot reach 4.5:1 with WHITE text (passes WCAG AA large-text 3:1)'}})()
